comments.text: Has someone who lives in Virginia, was born and raised in Virginia, and spent about 10 years in Southern California, I assure you no one who lives on the Delmarva Peninsula thinks what you are saying is a thing or cares about it.

comments.author: @stevevice9863
comments.text: I grew up in Salisbury, MD on the Delmarva peninsula.  Great little town. Half an hour from the Atlantic and half an hour from the Chesapeake Bay.   Great seafood and Ocean City is a fantastic beach town with lots to do.
